notes.inworld-ai: Vapi's Humanness Index isn't counted for either tool: ElevenLabs' current model isn't on it, so it can't compare them fairly.

notes.github-copilot: No benchmark tests Copilot as a product; it picks among several models, so model-only leaderboard results aren't credited.
notes.windsurf: Windsurf is now Devin Desktop (Cognition). The #2 Artificial Analysis result belongs to Cognition's Devin Fusion CLI, not the IDE, so it isn't counted.

notes.suno: Benchmarks rate Suno v6 first, but users dislike v6's mixes and the retirement of older models; Sony and UMG have filed a new lawsuit over v6.

notes.skybox-ai: No benchmark exists for skybox or tileable-material generators; the one usable review is from 2024.

notes.luma-ai: Luma's current model is Ray3.2 (June 2026); the only leaderboard entry is the older Ray 3, so it isn't counted.
notes.runway: Runway's app also offers third-party models (Kling, Seedance); these scores are for Runway's own Gen-4.5.

notes.crowdin: The only hands-on reviews are from 2021, before Crowdin's AI features, so they aren't counted.
notes.gridly: The only hands-on review is from 2021, before Gridly's 2025 rebuild, so it isn't counted.

notes.charisma-ai: Charisma now markets itself mainly for corporate training and brand campaigns; its Unity and Unreal plugins haven't been updated since Sept 2025.
notes.inworld-ai: Inworld has retired Character Studio and now positions itself as voice and model infrastructure.

notes.hunyuanworld: Tencent has replaced HunyuanWorld 1.0 with HY-World 2.0 (Apr 2026).
